paper_title: Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models
caption: Number of tasks by language family.
model_annotation: This horizontal bar chart illustrates the number of tasks categorized by language family. The vertical axis displays the categories, representing specific language families, without an explicit axis label. The horizontal axis represents the numerical values, labeled "# tasks," using a linear scale that ranges from 0 to 80, with tick marks and corresponding vertical grid lines spaced at intervals of 10 units. The chart contains ten separate horizontal bars, each filled with a distinct color and outlined in black, sorted in descending order of their length from top to bottom. The longest bar at the top represents the "IE-Slavic" category, colored light blue, with a value of approximately 79. This is followed sequentially by "IE-Romance" (dark blue, ~47), "IE-Germanic" (light green, ~44), "Uralic" (dark green, exactly 20), "IE-Baltic" (light pink, ~17), "IE-other" (dark red, ~15), "IE-Indic" (light tan, exactly 10), "Semitic" (dark orange, ~8), and "Turkic" (light purple, ~4). The shortest bar at the bottom corresponds to the "Basque" category, colored dark purple, with an approximate value of 3.
